months.note: 봄과 가을에 한반도를 지나가며, 번식지에서는 6월 하순~7월 상순에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 봄과 가을에 한반도 전역을 드물지 않게 지나가는 나그네새이다. 딱정벌레·메뚜기·파리 무리 같은 곤충을 주로 먹고 거미도 먹는다. 습지나 버드나무류가 드문드문 자라는 풀밭의 땅 위에 둥지를 틀고 한배에 알을 5개 낳는다. 유럽 동부와 시베리아 북부 등지에서 번식하고, 한국·중국·일본 등을 거쳐 동남아시아 열대에서 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: Pechora Pipit (Anthus gustavi), adult on spring passage (sexes alike): crown brown with dark streaks; indistinct pale supercilium; brown ear-coverts with dark streaks; upperparts warm brown with broad, bold blackish-brown streaks and two whitish stripes ('braces') down the sides of the mantle; two whitish wing-bars on the median and greater coverts; underparts buffy-white, the breast buff with bold blackish-brown streaks and the flanks with long dark streaks; small blackish-brown spots along the malar; belly white; bill brown with a pale brownish-pink base to the lower mandible; dark eye; pinkish legs.
art.pose: walking on the ground, picking insects from the grass
art.scene: Korean spring migration stopover: damp grassy ground beside a wetland with scattered willows; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view walking in grass: bold black-streaked brown upperparts, whitish mantle braces, two whitish wing-bars, buffy-white underparts with dark breast streaks and long flank streaks, pink legs
adult, seen from above on the ground: two whitish braces on the boldly black-streaked mantle, streaked crown and rump, two whitish wing-bars
adult, head in profile: indistinct supercilium, streaked brown ear-coverts, small blackish-brown malar spots, brown bill with a pale base to the lower mandible
art.build: Small, slim pipit, about 14cm — about sparrow length but slimmer and longer-legged, with a horizontal posture. Bill slender, pointed, shorter than the head. Legs pinkish, with a long hind claw. At rest the primary tips project slightly beyond the tertials. Tail medium-length and notched, with pale outer feathers. Skulking: creeps in damp grass, walks rather than hops, and rarely flies far.
avoid: Do not omit the two whitish 'braces' on the black-streaked mantle — the mark behind its Korean name.
Do not paint a plain olive back with a white-and-black ear spot (Olive-backed Pipit, Anthus hodgsoni).
Do not give it a bold, long supercilium; the face is rather plain.
Do not paint a rusty-red throat (Red-throated Pipit) or dark legs.
